## Statistical Validation

Repeated TD3 training runs can diverge due to random initialization, replay
sampling, and exploration noise, even under an identical dataset and
configuration — the same single-run limitation already noted for the
Hypothesis 1 comparison above applies throughout this chapter. Repeated tuning on the
same validation period can also bias later comparisons, and reward-based
metrics can diverge from financial objectives when the reward is a shaped
training signal rather than realized return. Final claims are read together
with the robustness assessment and economic interpretation that follow.
